name: docs-features-tls-md-00
yaml:
services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"
      - "4545:4545"
    volumes:
      - ./certs:/certs:ro
      - ./imposters.json:/imposters.json:ro
    command: ["--configfile", "/imposters.json",
              "--default-tls-cert", "/certs/server.crt",
              "--default-tls-key", "/certs/server.key"]
